title: Tolaria: an offline-first Markdown knowledge base with a built-in MCP server
description:
Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea turned into a production-ready app. Tolaria is an offline-first knowledge base for macOS and Linux. Plain Markdown files in a folder, Git-backed with auto-sync. Notion-style feel, total file ownership. The killer feature is the MCP server registration. Claude Code and OpenClaw read, search, and update your knowledge base directly while you work. Your second brain, accessible to every agent in your workflow.

https://github.com/refactoringhq/tolaria

#github #opensource
